title: the ladder between earth and heaven

verses.text: And Jacob had a dream about a ladder that rested on the earth with its top reaching up to heaven, and God’s angels were going up and down the ladder.

caption:
God met Jacob in the middle of nowhere, on the night he was running.

He lay down with a stone for a pillow and no plan worth the name. What came to him in his sleep was a ladder set on the ground and reaching all the way up, with angels moving both directions on it. The place he thought was empty turned out to be a doorway.

Genesis 28:12 (BSB)
